import_policy.duplicate_authority_rule: Backend source is canonical where a backend blueprint exists; legacy frontend sources are drift evidence only.
import_policy.omitted_source_rule: Do not invent records for a kind or identifier absent from the enumerated repository sources.

legacy_registry_authority.import_behavior: No environment-supplied legacy integration record is copied into committed evidence. Runtime records require independent credential-safe evidence reconciliation before any Phase 203 lifecycle transition.
legacy_registry_authority.authority_boundary: The legacy contract and fail-closed execution authorization remain valid runtime authority during migration; the Phase 203 source inventory does not infer ACTIVE or SELLABLE from legacy stage names.
